description: Land Title Settlement Department - Dethgama, Meerigama D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No.510210
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, identity card numbers, and encumbrances. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land ownership and title settlement, making it clearly a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than government personnel/structure or other specialized categories.
